title: PostgreSQL plperl array and hash conversion use-after-free executes arbitrary code (CVE-2026-116320)
description: A use-after-free vulnerability exists in the PostgreSQL plperl procedural language handler, allowing an attacker who can create Perl array or hash objects to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database. This occurs when PostgreSQL drops the final reference to a Perl array or hash during conversion. Versions prior to 14.25, 15.20, 16.16, 17.12, and 18.7 are affected.
